def solve(N, C, P):
    # Sort the positions of the officers
    P.sort()
    
    # Initialize the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated
    max_eliminated = 0
    
    # Chef's turn to move
    while True:
        # Chef's possible moves
        moves = [C - 1, C + 1]
        
        # Check if Chef can move to any of the possible positions
        if any(move in P for move in moves):
            # Chef moves to an adjacent unoccupied cell
            if C - 1 in P:
                C = C - 1
            else:
                C = C + 1
        else:
            # Chef cannot move, so he gets caught
            return max_eliminated, -1
        
        # Officers' turn to move
        officers_moves = []
        for officer in P:
            for move in [officer - 1, officer + 1]:
                if move != C and move not in P:
                    officers_moves.append(move)
        
        # If no officers can move, Chef runs away
        if not officers_moves:
            return max_eliminated, 1
        
        # Officers move to the possible positions
        P = officers_moves
        
        # Chef's turn to move again
        # Count the number of officers eliminated
        max_eliminated += len(P) - len(officers_moves)
